nom: HALEYS Beauty Re-move Zero Residue Nourishing Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: This is the best makeup remover i have EVER used. I have to wear waterproof mascara due to watery eyes and sweating all the time. I have always used Neutrogena makeup remover but I recently checked it on Yuka and its ingredients are super toxic. The ingredients in this are great and work BETTER!! I take half the time to remove my mascara and i can just use my fingertips, not cotton pads. It also smells natural and soooo good. Annnnd it left my skin so soft, not greasy at all. HIGHLY reccomend.

I have super sensitive skin and I've religiously used the Banila Co cleansing balm for the last two years. Any time I use other facial cleansers, my face acts up. I have combo type skin and wear makeup every day. This cleansing oil managed to fix a lot of texture issues I had in a week and my skin feels so soft after I'm done using it. I also love that the applicator tip doesn't go crazy when I'm pouring it into my hand. It has a steady drip and you can squeeze tbe bottle to get more out quickly. It's easy to throw in your gym bag should you want to wash your face after a workout. The smell is pleasant as well. It almost smells faintly of rosemary. Will definitely be repurchasing! Great price and lots of product!

I was Gifted by haleysbeauty in exchange for my honest review. This got makeup off beautifully! A little goes a long way and it got off lip stain and mascara and eyeliner. It smells slightly minty to me so it has a good smell as well.

I received the Re-move Nourishing Cleansing Oil as a complimentary from Haleys Beauty and I'm really impressed with it ! It easily melts away makeup (even waterproof mascara and SPF) and rinses off cleanly with no greasy residue. My skin feels soft and balanced afterward—not stripped or tight. I also love that it's made with just 9 gentle ingredients, and it hasn't caused any breakouts. Compared to other oil cleansers I've used, this one is lighter, faster to rinse, and super travel-friendly. Bonus: it works great for cleaning makeup brushes too!

complimentary from Haleys beauty. I'm sometime who double cleanses regularly. This product took me by surprise and I'm pleased to say it's on par with the Asian products. It removes make up and sweat without being too harsh or drying. Very safe and effective to use.

*gifted by haleysbeauty* Haley's Re•move Nourishing Cleansing Oil is a great addition to my skincare routine and has made my skin feel hydrated and refreshed. I use this cleansing oil daily in my skincare routine .

This oil cleanser is great. It gently but effectively removes a days worth of buildup and makeup. It leaves skin feel clean and so nourished. I love that it's a low ingredient product - packed with nourishing fatty acids and antioxidants. Complimentary from haleysbeauty

Gifted by haleysbeauty ! I am someone who pays attention to ingredients so I was very happy with the ingredients in this. It takes my makeup off so smoothly and easily! I also really love the bottle on this, I don't know why but it is so satisfying

i really enjoyed this oil cleanser. i like to use rhem to remove my sunscreen at night before my double cleanse. it didnt burn my eyes which is nice bc most usually do burn my eues and it didnt make it cloudy either. Gifted by haleysbeauty

I received this product in exchange for this review. Honestly, I really enjoyed it. It really helped take off my makeup after a long day. I normally wear waterproof makeup or stains that a lot of makeup remover struggle to take off. Gifted by Haley beauty

I was in big need of a makeup cleanser and this one is perfect! Took all my makeup off and I love the shape of the bottle. It doesn't leave a residue on me and it feels nice on the skin. Gifted by haleysbeauty

Gifted by haleysbeauty, so far this takes all of my makeup off completely!! My waterproof mascara came off so easily with this oil. It really breaks down the makeup and I also double cleanse after this.

I have yet to find a product that could fully take care of my make up removing needs. I think I finally found the solution! I have never used a cleansing oil to remove make up, and after a couple uses, this is definitely my go to. This product not only helped removed all my mascara and eyeliner, but my face didn't feel stripped for moisture and felt hydrated. I highly recommend this product!

It's a good oil cleanser to breakdown my makeup. I use it as my first step and follow it up with a gel cleanser. It's a good value because it's a big bottle and you don't need to use much of it. This was gifted by Haley's.

This is an awesome addition to my skincare routine. It easily melts away all my makeup, including waterproof mascara, without any rubbing or leaving a greasy residue. My skin feels incredibly clean, soft, and nourished after using it, not tight or stripped. It's gentle but super effective, and it rinses off nicely. I love that it leaves my skin feeling hydrated and prepped for the next steps in my routine. Gifted by Haleys

I received the Re-move Nourishing Cleansing Oil complimentary from haleysbeauty, and I'm truly impressed! It melts away makeup effortlessly and leaves my skin feeling soft, clean, and hydrated without any greasy residue. Love it!

This multipurpose oil is formulated with over 9 natural oils. It melts away all makeup — even the most stubborn waterproof mascara. I also love using it to break down makeup residue on used brushes. Super effective and gentle! Gifted by haleysbeauty

I have been using this cleansing oil everyday because i wanted to give it a try, I have to say that im obsessed with how well this product works. It removes every little bit of makeup and leaves my skin feeling amazing and clean. Gifted by Haleys Beauty

First, I love the bottle - a squeeze bottle is perfect for an oil product and immediately sold me. The cleansing oil works great, gets all of my makeup off with no problem and doesn't leave my skin feeling weird. Definitely suggest! Gifted by haleysbeauty.

This cleansing oil is incredible. It melts away my makeup and leaves my skin hydrated. It's not sticky or runny and even makes my stubborn mascara melt away. I love the packaging and squeeze bottle. It's also nice that the oil is already in liquid form so I don't have to melt anything in my hands. I was gifted by Haley's beauty.

Mess free As far as the product goes, it really does melt all of my makeup off. Especially that hard waterproof mascara, gentle on the eyes. It doesn't leave my skin feeling oily afterwards, but it isn't drying either. Leaves a very nice glowy finish and I would definitely be using this everyday. -gifted by haleysbeauty

Omg this cleansing oil is THEEEEE best, I love how it doesn't feel too oily. It has like a soapy texture so if you don't like oil this is def for you because it gets really IN your skin and makes you feel super clean afterwards !!! Gifted by haleysbeauty

First time checking out this Haleys Beauty cleansing oil. The bottle has a squeeze nozzle for dispensing the oil which is easy to use. The fragrance is super light and mostly herbaly, and feels soothing and calming when I applied it. Easy to use and removes makeup well! Gifted by Haleys Beauty.

This cleansing oil effortlessly removes even the most stubborn makeup, including waterproof mascara and long-wear foundation. After rinsing, my skin feels clean, hydrated, and incredibly soft. complimentary from haleysbeauty

This was gifted by Haley beauty for my honest feedback. As you can see in the video, I used this oil cleanser to remove my eye makeup. I love how easily it removed my mascara. I love this cleansing oil I have been using it for a few days and it leaves my skin feeling soo clean and melts my makeup and sunscreen off so easily I would highly recommend it especially to the acne girlys! Gifted to me by haleysbeauty

This nourishing cleansing oil by re-move is amazing. Tis oil is perfect to melt away makeup at the end of the day. It effectively removes all makeup and impurities. I received this oil complimentary from haleysbeauty.

I love this cleansing oil with its subtle herbal scent. It has a low consistency, similar to a thicker toner, making it very spreadable. The applicator is great for targeted application, and it efficiently removes makeup. It's complimentary from haleys beauty

I adore this product that was gifted to me. It is very hydrating and nourishing. I feel as though it cleanses my poor deeply and thoroughly. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and glowy. A must have in my skincare routine!

This cleansing oil is really good . It's not thick or really oily. It does remove all your make up and sunscreen. I would like the packaging better if it had a pump but other than that it's a really good cleansing oil. #giftedbyhaleysbeauty

This product was gifted by haleysbeauty, and I couldn't be happier! After a long day at work, I was eager to remove my makeup, and this cleansing oil worked wonders—it effortlessly melted away all traces of makeup. Unlike other removers that can be harsh, this one was soothing and felt almost therapeutic. The rosemary oil added a calming and relaxing touch, perfect for unwinding after a busy day. Best of all, it didn't leave my skin feeling greasy, and the oil was easy to remove. I'm certain I'll be buying this for myself once this bottle runs out. I highly recommend this product!

This cleansing oil is effective at removing makeup and sunscreen. The plastic bottle is easy to squeeze for dispensing. After use, my skin feels soft and clean. However, it has a strong herbal rosemary scent. This product was provided complimentary from Haleys Beauty.

Gifted by Haley's beauty. I'm getting more into cleansing oils and was excited to try this one. This oil removed all my makeup including my waterproof mascara. I have dry skin and it left my skin feeling nourished as well. Definitely a good cleansing oil.

This oil cleanser removes all my makeup, even stubborn mascara, without stripping my skin's natural oils. Plus, it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and nourished, no tight feeling at all! I love that it's packed with good-for-your-skin ingredients like jojoba and grapeseed oil. For the amazing way it removes makeup without drying out my skin, this cleansing oil is a winner!

I wasn't sure on this Cleansing Oil at first because it is thicker than others that I had used before. I have extremely oily skin, so that concerned me. However, after using it for a few days, I have noticed a huge difference in my hormonal acne. Not sure what is in this to help that other than possibly it is just giving me a deeper clean, but whatever it is, I love it!!
It takes off most if my makeup. It takes a minute to remove my waterproof smudge proof mascara, but it helps breaks it down. Works best with gel cleansers.

avis.titre: Watch this makeup remover melt your makeup !!
avis.texte: I feel the oil melts the makeup without irritating the skin n leaves a tingling feeling afterwards it sets up the clean face for the serum n moisturizer. Thank you. It works great esp for my eye makeup.

avis.titre: A forever staple in my routine
avis.texte: After using this cleansing oil for the last couple of weeks, I can confidently say that I'll be repurchasing this cleansing oil for the rest of my life (please never discontinue it). Not only does it effortlessly remove my makeup, it genuinely leaves my skin feeling as fresh, clean and radiant as the description claims. I've seen a noticeable difference in my pores + skin texture, and look forward to taking off my makeup just to use this product!

I have really oily skin, so I was hesitant to try an oil based cleanser since I break out easily. After using Re-move for nearly a month, I can honestly say this has been the best cleanser for my skin type. No break outs, irritation, dryness or splotchy skin. My skin feels perfectly soft and hydrated even though I use this cleanser 2-3x a day. I hate it when I overwash my face and then it becomes irritated and red. I also feel like it has some magical powers b/c I feel that my oiliness has subsided since using an oil cleanser. It also takes off all my makeup (even waterproof eyeliner) at the end of the day. I've already replenished my Re-move and on my 2nd bottle. The smell is also light and herbal. Also easy to pack for travel too.

I definitely enjoyed using this cleansing oil. It felt super lightweight in contrast to other cleansing oils (ie. DHC's deep cleansing oil) and removed my eye makeup really well. My only problem was I felt I had to use a bit of oil to completely cleanse my face, but I suppose that might be the trade-off with it feeling so light. Overall, great experience with this cleansing oil.

The Re-Move Cleansing Oil was incredibly easy to use and apply. It rinsed off quickly and effectively removed all my makeup, including my stubborn waterproof liquid eyeliner and mascara. Unlike some oil cleansers, it didn't leave my face feeling greasy. Nor did my eyes sting! On the contrary, my face felt clean and refreshed. Just to be sure, I even double-checked by using some makeup remover on a cotton pad, and to my surprise, there was nothing left! I appreciate that this cleanser has only a few ingredients, doesn't strip my face, and leaves it feeling clean and moisturized. I highly recommend!!

When I use this cleanser, it feels like I'm at the spa! It smells so refreshing & earthy. I love that it feels strong enough to remove my daily makeup wear, yet afterwards my skin feels soooo soft & smooth. It feels and smells like a very high-end product but for such a reasonable price! I would highly recommend to anyone.

Every other "makeup remover" I've used has been oily and left my skin feeling greasy. Re-Move clearly is made with natural, enriching ingredients because my skin felt like a million bucks after using this product for the first time!

Removes my waterproof makeup and full coverage makeup with ease. Love the refreshing smell of this cleanser. I use this cleanser even when I don't wear makeup because it makes my skin feel so soft and clean! I was using a cleansing balm before but Re-move is much more travel-friendly and it comes with A LOT more product. 11/10 recommend!

I love this cleansing oil! It's so easy to apply and washes away easily without leaving any residue behind. It leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. I also really like the smell and the packaging! It removes most of my makeup (a little bit of stubborn waterproof mascara is left behind), but it's very easy to remove after using this product. I'd highly recommend this oil to anyone who's thinking of trying it! It does a great job cleansing your skin without drying it out.

Easy to remove every trace of make-up or impurities with a small dab. My skin feels like it had a mini spa treatment with minimal effort. It's easy to wash off leaving my face smooth and soft. My skin looked radiant since I started using this cleanser. Re-move does everything I want for my face and more.

I purchased this cleansing oil as a makeup remover option and love this new product! It's one of the only makeup removers that doesn't leave my skin dry after use and I smell like a spa after! My skin feels very nourished and healthy after my makeup removal routine. I would highly recommend trying this!

My skin is very dry and sensitive. When I apply eyeliner (regular or waterproof) scrubbing it with face wash or wiping it with a makeup removal cloth always leaves my skin burning. This oil based cleanser was so easy to use and didn't make my skin feeling stripped of all the moisture. It felt my skin feeling hydrated and clean. Love the product and it's cost effective than using some of the other oil based cleansers !

I've tried many cleansing oils previously and I really love this one because the scent is light (not too strong), oil is perfectly balanced (not too oily) and price. I also took it on the weekend trip and thought the nozzle was great because my normal pump would leak out into my suitcase. This is my new fave!

I was skeptical to try since most makeup remover oils leave an oily residue on my skin. This product just changed the game for me! Not only did it remove all of my makeup, even my frustrating mascara, but it left my skin feeling nourished and hydrated without feeling oily! Also so many cleansing products strip make my skin feel stripped of all moisture, but the cleansing oil has the perfect balance. Love this product!!!

I started using this about a week and a half ago and see such a difference in my skin. Not only does it remove makeup super easily, but it leaves my skin feeling nourished and moist. In the past others have clogged my pores, or been too oily, this one is the right amount of everything. I actually look forward to cleansing my face at the end of the day now because I love the way it feels afterwards.

I've double cleansed for years now, and this is now my go-to cleansing oil. While I wasn't accustomed to a thicker feeling oil, it washed off easily leaving no residue and actually left my skin more supple. I typically do a last step with micellar water, but found this cleansing oil took off all my makeup including foundation and eyeliner (I don't wear waterproof so can't speak to this)
Re-move successfully removed all my makeup and left my face feeling soft and smooth!

avis.titre: My skin has never felt cleaner!
avis.texte: I've always been guarded about the idea of putting oil on my face and near my eyes to clean my makeup off, but I'm so glad I gave this product a try - IT ACTUALLY WORKS! I watched the cleansing oil remove my eyeshadow immediately and no oily residue is left behind. My skin feels so soft and refreshed after I use it and my foundation literally glides on the next day. 100% recommend!!
